title: W's Rotomite
description: Replaces boring Netherite with flashy Rotomite!
body:
**Netherite is boring. Let's fix that.**

What started as a "what if" with a couple of mutuals quickly devolved into a resource pack adventure. Originally, I wanted to make a multitool mod, but after remembering I have no idea _how_ to mod, I decided to just replace netherite. 

This pack does nothing but replace all Netherite-related items with a much more... noticeable... Rotomite. 

Future updates (no promises)
- Animated tools
- Emmissive layers

Enjoy it. Or don't.
